rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: The Cyb MCP Server enables AI agents to interact with the Cyber blockchain network, a decentralized knowledge graph built on IPFS and Cosmos SDK technology. Developed as a contribution to the Great Web Foundation, it provides three core tools: creating cyberlinks between IPFS content hashes to build semantic connections, searching the existing knowledge graph with optional content retrieval, and fetching content directly from IPFS through Cyber's gateway. The server operates in two modes - read-only for exploration without requiring wallet credentials, or full mode with mnemonic phrase support for creating new cyberlinks and signing blockchain transactions, making it valuable for building decentralized knowledge applications and contributing to censorship-resistant web infrastructure.
